questions.q: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart?
questions.why: The pulmonary vein carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

questions.q: A performer has a stroke volume of 80 ml and a heart rate of 70 bpm. What is the cardiac output?
questions.why: Cardiac output = stroke volume × heart rate = 80 × 70 = 5,600 ml/min.

questions.q: Which of these describes the air left in the lungs after the biggest possible exhalation?
questions.why: Residual volume is the air that always remains in the lungs.

questions.q: Explain two ways in which the alveoli are adapted for gaseous exchange.
questions.model: The alveoli have walls one cell thick, so diffusion distance is short. They are surrounded by a network of capillaries, which keeps a steep concentration gradient by removing oxygen. They also have a large total surface area.
points: Thin walls / one cell thick, short diffusion distance
Capillary network maintains concentration gradient (or large surface area)
